businessModel: Ad-funded: start-page news feed, content and ads; Alibaba ecosystem
updateCadence: Irregular; current cadence not independently verified
summary: UC Browser is Alibaba's mobile browser known for proxy compression and a strong download manager. Citizen Lab and others documented insecure data handling; it is Android-only today and banned in India.
bestFor: Low-bandwidth Android users who value download manager
Markets where UC is the default familiar app
notFor: Anyone who cares about privacy or security

pros.title: Strong downloader
pros.detail: Multi-threaded download manager is a long-time signature.

pros.title: Light on weak devices
pros.detail: Runs acceptably on low-end Android phones.

pros.title: Built-in ad blocking
pros.detail: Ad blocking is offered in the app (depth unverified).

cons.title: Privacy record
cons.detail: Citizen Lab found personal data sent with weak encryption; Forbes (2021) reported IPs going to Alibaba.

cons.title: Proxy architecture
cons.detail: Pages route through UCWeb servers, which weakens HTTPS guarantees.

cons.title: Android-only
cons.detail: Wikipedia says only Android is supported as of 2025.

cons.title: Banned in India
cons.detail: Banned in 2020 along with 58 other Chinese apps.

cons.title: Weak patching evidence
cons.detail: No verifiable security release cadence or Chromium base.

faq.a: Independent researchers (Citizen Lab, Doctor Web) documented serious privacy and security flaws; treat it as high-risk.
Wikipedia lists Android 15.1.2.1388 from March 2026, but the entry is flagged citation needed.

faq.q: Can I use it on iOS or Windows?
faq.a: No. Wikipedia states Android is the only supported platform as of 2025.

timeline.event: Citizen Lab and Snowden documents flag privacy leaks
Banned in India with 58 other Chinese apps; Google Play version re-added with compliant settings
Reports of IP addresses sent to Alibaba servers

switching.note: Limited import tools found; mostly account-based sync.

spec.sandbox: Android app sandbox; own engine kernel

privacyDefaults: Traffic via UCWeb servers by default
longevity: Large legacy base but narrowing platforms

featureNotes.privateHardening: Reports of data logged in incognito

sources.title: Citizen Lab - A Tough Nut to Crack

unverified: Whether VPN or proxy modes are still present
